'''Floating Toads of Doom''' were a part of the arcade game [[Wookiee Warpath]]. When [[Chuck Bratz]] played the video game as [[Gender/Legends|his]] brother, [[Donni Bratz]], watched, Chuck caused all of the Floating Toads of Doom to explode.<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
